36799-the-history-of-the-last-trial-by-j.title: The History Of The Last Trial By Jury For Atheism In England
36799-the-history-of-the-last-trial-by-j.creator: George Jacob Holyoake
36799-the-history-of-the-last-trial-by-j.description: A book by George Jacob Holyoake. There are some passages in these Fragments over which some will be sad with me. Others will assume them to be written for effect; for such, let me say, they were not written at all. These pages will leave me for the press with much more pleasure if I can believe that no one will connect them with me, but read them as a posthumous record of bygone events.

76920-expelled.title: Expelled
76920-expelled.creator: Unknown
76920-expelled.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "I daresay," said Eleanor--Nelly, she was called. She was a quiet girl was Nelly, quiet and demure; she never shouted, and when she laughed, it was as different a laugh from Marion's as it was possible for laugh to be; there was a primness in her voice, her tones were never raised, untidiness was impossible with her; never a pin was out of place, never a button was off her boots, never a lace was left undone; yet every one loved Nelly.

arxiv-2303-01564.title: Higher-harmonic generation in boron-doped silicon from band carriers and bound-dopant photoionization
arxiv-2303-01564.creator: Fanqi Meng, Frederik Walla, Sergey Kovalev, Jan-Christoph Deinert, Igor Ilyakov, Min Chen, Alexey Ponomaryov, Sergey G. Pavlov, Heinz-Wilhelm Hübers, Nikolay V. Abrosimov, Christoph Jungemann, Hartmut G. Roskos, Mark D. Thomson
arxiv-2303-01564.description: Abstract We investigate ultrafast harmonic generation (HG) in Si:B, driven by intense pump pulses with fields reaching ∼ \sim 100 kVcm − 1 ~\mathrm{kV}\mathrm{cm}^{-1} and a carrier frequency of 300 GHz, at 4 K and 300 K, both experimentally and theoretically. We report several novel findings concerning the nonlinear charge carrier dynamics in intense sub-THz fields.

arxiv-2401-00908.title: DocLLM: A layout-aware generative language model for multimodal document understanding
arxiv-2401-00908.creator: Dongsheng Wang, Natraj Raman, Mathieu Sibue Zhiqiang Ma, Petr Babkin, Simerjot Kaur, Yulong Pei, Armineh Nourbakhsh, Xiaomo Liu JPMorgan AI Research {first.last}@jpmchase.com
arxiv-2401-00908.description: Abstract Enterprise documents such as forms, invoices, receipts, reports, contracts, and other similar records, often carry rich semantics at the intersection of textual and spatial modalities. The visual cues offered by their complex layouts play a crucial role in comprehending these documents effectively.

arxiv-2407-10679.title: Resilience of Snowball Earth to Stochastic Events
arxiv-2407-10679.creator: Guillaume Chaverot, Andrea Zorzi, Xuesong Ding, Jonathan Itcovitz, Bowen Fan, Siddharth Bhatnagar, Aoshuang Ji, Robert J. Graham, Tushar Mittal
arxiv-2407-10679.description: Abstract Earth went through at least two periods of global glaciation (i.e., “Snowball Earth” states) during the Neoproterozoic, the shortest of which (the Marinoan) may not have lasted sufficiently long for its termination to be explained by the gradual volcanic build-up of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere.

arxiv-2407-13007.title: MagAO-X: Commissioning Results and Status of Ongoing Upgrades
arxiv-2407-13007.creator: Jared R. Males, Laird M. Close, Sebastiaan Y. Haffert, Maggie Y. Kautz, Jay Kueny, Joseph D. Long, Eden McEwen, Noah Swimmer, John I. Bailey, III, Warren Foster, Benjamin A. Mazin, Logan Pearce, Joshua Liberman, Katie Twitchell, Alycia J. Weinberger, Olivier Guyon, Alexander D. Hedglen, Avalon McLeo
arxiv-2407-13007.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jared R. Males, Laird M. Close, Sebastiaan Y. Haffert, Maggie Y. Kautz, Jay Kueny, Joseph D. Long, Eden McEwen, Noah Swimmer, John I. Bailey, III, Warren Foster, Benjamin A. Mazin, Logan Pearce, Joshua Liberman, Katie Twitchell, Alycia J. Weinberger, Olivier Guyon, Alexander D. Hedglen, Avalon McLeo. MagAO-X is the coronagraphic extreme adaptive optics system for the 6.5 m Magellan Clay Telescope. We report the results of commissioning the first phase of MagAO-X.

arxiv-2412-11230.title: Grey Wolf-Based Task Scheduling in Vehicular Fog Computing Systems
arxiv-2412-11230.creator: Maryam Taghizadeh, Mahmood Ahmadi
arxiv-2412-11230.description: Abstract Vehicular fog computing (VFC) can be considered as an important alternative to address the existing challenges in intelligent transportation systems (ITS). The main purpose of VFC is to perform computational tasks through various vehicles. At present, VFCs include powerful computing resources that bring the computational resources nearer to the requesting devices.

arxiv-2510-01584.title: Directionality and quantum backfire in continuous-time quantum walks from delocalized states: Exact results
arxiv-2510-01584.creator: Jefferson J. Ximenes 1, Marcelo A. Pires 2, José M. Villas-Bôas 1
arxiv-2510-01584.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jefferson J. Ximenes 1, Marcelo A. Pires 2, José M. Villas-Bôas 1. We derive analytical results for continuous-time quantum walks from a new class of initial states with tunable delocalization. The dynamics are governed by a Hamiltonian with complex hopping amplitudes.

arxiv-2510-07418.title: Alpha-bit state merging
arxiv-2510-07418.creator: Jessica Yeh, Jinzhao Wang, Patrick Hayden
arxiv-2510-07418.description: Abstract State merging is a fundamental protocol in quantum information theory that generalizes quantum teleportation. Traditionally, it is achieved by local operations on shared entanglement and classical communication. In this work, we study state merging done with α \alpha -bits , a versatile quantum communication resource weaker than qubits.

arxiv-2510-17958.title: Attributing the O’Connell effect in contact binaries to a cooling mass-transfer stream
arxiv-2510-17958.creator: Matthias Fabry, Andrej Prša
arxiv-2510-17958.description: Abstract Contact binaries are very short-period systems that are continuously interacting by transferring mass and energy. Obtaining large, statistical samples of contact binaries from photometric surveys can put valuable constraints on the various processes involved in their evolution. Modeling those systems however present some challenges.

arxiv-2512-25027.title: Computational Analysis of Disease Progression in Pediatric Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension
arxiv-2512-25027.creator: Omar Said, Christopher Tossas-Betancourt, Mary K. Olive, Jimmy C. Lu, Adam Dorfman, C. Alberto Figueroa
arxiv-2512-25027.description: Abstract Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) is a progressive cardiopulmonary disease that leads to increased pulmonary pressures, vascular remodeling, and eventual right ventricular (RV) failure. Pediatric PAH remains understudied due to limited data and the lack of targeted diagnostic and therapeutic strategies.

arxiv-2601-20049.title: Evolving beyond collapse: An adaptive particle batch smoother for cryospheric data assimilation
arxiv-2601-20049.description: Abstract We present a new adaptive particle-based data assimilation scheme for cryospheric applications that leverages promising developments in importance sampling. Beyond our cryospheric focus, the scheme has the potential to be applied directly to the closely related fields of land surface and hydrological data assimilation as well as more general geoscientific Bayesian inference problems.

arxiv-2606-18953.creator: Kinam Kim, Namiko Saito, Heecheol Kim, Katsushi Ikeuchi, Jaegul Choo, Yasuyuki Matsushita

pmc-10572914.title: Enhanced Elderberry Snack Bars: A Sensory, Nutritional, and Rheological Evaluation
pmc-10572914.creator: Ioana Mariana Haș, Dan-Cristian Vodnar, Alexa Florina Bungau, Alexandra Georgiana Tarce, Delia Mirela Tit, Bernadette-Emőke Teleky
pmc-10572914.description: Interest in functional foods is continuously increasing, having the potential to be an ally in reducing cardiometabolic risk factors. This study focuses on developing and evaluating oat- and millet-based snack bars enriched with freeze-dried elderberry powder (FDEBP), aiming to combine great taste with enhanced nutritional value, antioxidant properties, and prebiotic potential.

pmc-10579780.title: Isolation, characterization, and fibroblast uptake of bacterial extracellular vesicles from Porphyromonas gingivalis strains
pmc-10579780.creator: Helene R Haugsten, Anne K Kristoffersen, Trude M Haug, Tine M Søland, Reidun Øvstebø, Hans C D Aass, Morten Enersen, Hilde K Galtung
pmc-10579780.description: Periodontitis is an inflammatory condition caused by bacteria and represents a serious health problem worldwide as the inflammation damages the supporting tissues of the teeth and may predispose to systemic diseases. Porphyromonas gingivalis is considered a keystone periodontal pathogen that releases bacterial extracellular vesicles (bEVs) containing virulence factors, such as gingipains, that may contribute to the pathogenesis of periodontitis.

pmc-10608785.title: A SIRT6 Inhibitor, Marine-Derived Pyrrole-Pyridinimidazole Derivative 8a, Suppresses Angiogenesis
pmc-10608785.creator: Nannan Song, Yanfei Tang, Yangui Wang, Xian Guan, Wengong Yu, Tao Jiang, Ling Lu, Yuchao Gu, Sergey A Dyshlovoy
pmc-10608785.description: Angiogenesis refers to the process of growing new blood vessels from pre-existing capillaries or post-capillary veins. This process plays a critical role in promoting tumorigenesis and metastasis. As a result, developing antiangiogenic agents has become an attractive strategy for tumor treatment.

pmc-11725324.title: Endoscopic Management of Concomitant Malignant Biliary and Gastric Outlet Obstruction
pmc-11725324.creator: Intekhab Hossain, Hannah Jardine, Keeran Bonia, Bradley Evans
pmc-11725324.description: Concurrent malignant biliary and gastric outlet obstruction requires urgent palliative intervention to improve patient quality of life and permit systemic therapy. Traditional management has been surgical gastrojejunostomy and hepaticojejunostomy, two morbid procedures. Comparatively, endoscopic stenting can relieve both sites of obstruction with less complications and quicker recovery.

pmc-12634357.title: Mindfulness training combined with cold water immersion effects on mood and perception of executive functioning in middle-aged and older adults: a pilot study
pmc-12634357.creator: Ambra Gentile, Sara Vivirito, Musa Kirkar, Konstantinos Paschos, Luka Tuđan, Jakub Kulhánek, Pelin Öztürk, Marianna Alesi
pmc-12634357.description: BackgroundAge-related cognitive decline typically begins during middle age and persists into old age. In parallel, mood (and, in particular, anxiety and depression) can be a significant predictor of neurodegenerative pathologies. To prevent these negative consequences, mindfulness trainings were used to improve mood and executive functioning in middle-aged and older adults.

pmc-13036613.title: Translation, cultural adaptation, and preliminary data evaluation of the Standardized Tool for the Assessment of Bruxism (STAB) and BruxScreen in Turkey
pmc-13036613.creator: Berk Bilgen, Mehmet Berk Kaffaf, Pınar Şeşen, Sina Saygılı, Ayşenur Özcan-Sezgin, Süleyman Çağatay Dayan, Hanefi Kurt, Olcay Şakar, Frank Lobbezoo, Daniele Manfredini
pmc-13036613.description: Background: The Standardized Tool for the Assessment of Bruxism (STAB) and Bruxism Screener (BruxScreen) are instruments developed to support the structured evaluation of bruxism across clinical and research settings. For effective use in different populations, translation, cultural adaptation, and preliminary data collection are essential.

pmc-13490640.title: Imported Malaria in Qazvin Province, Iran: A Retrospective Study From 2008 to 2023
pmc-13490640.creator: Badri Milad, Modarresnia Leila, Asghari Ali, Olfatifar Meysam, Sgroi Giovanni, Najafpour Behzad, Bagheri Hadi, Nikkhahi Farhad, Karampour Amin, Vafae Eslahi Aida
pmc-13490640.description: Introduction: Malaria remains a significant public health challenge worldwide, particularly in tropical and subtropical regions where it is associated with high morbidity and mortality rates. Although Iran has made substantial progress in malaria elimination, imported cases continue to pose a threat to these achievements.

uslaw-usc-t36-s152707.title: 36 U.S.C. § 152707 — Restrictions
uslaw-usc-t36-s152707.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s152707.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 1527 (National Ski Patrol System, Incorporated). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Stock and Dividends.— The corporation may not issue stock or declare or pay a dividend. (b) Political Activities.— The corporation or a director or officer as such may not contribute to, support, or participate.
